name: Reso: a tuned resonator on every track, Pitch on SWEEP, Amount on CONTOUR, Decay on COLOR, Brightness on SHAPE
description: An effect of model27's Track FX (the filter slot of notes/72, which holds effects too since fltslot 0.7, notes/73), on any track whose sound chose it (RETRIG + PITCH), after Volume + Dist: a comb, one line a track read a period back and fed again, damped in the loop, so that noise and hits ring at a pitch with its harmonics (notes/75). RETRIG + SWEEP is Pitch, the MIDI note (60 = C4, 8 Hz to 12.5 kHz; a sound that steps to Reso starts at C4); RETRIG + CONTOUR is Amount, 0 the track untouched, bit for bit (where a sound starts), 127 the resonance alone; RETRIG + COLOR is Decay, 20 ms to 10 s for the pitch to fall by 60 dB; RETRIG + SHAPE is Brightness, from dull (the harmonics die fast) to every harmonic ringing as long as the pitch at 127. All four are real parameters of every machine: p-locks, LFO, velocity, Control All, CC 74 and 71 on Pitch and Amount. The pitch cannot follow the played note: it is the knob's, and a p-lock's.

uses.name: Reso
uses.why: an effect of the Track FX (the filter slot): called after Volume + Dist as (block, k 28 to k 31, track, triggered) on the tracks whose sound chose id 4

emulation.pattern: instructions per track and block, Reso's own code only, on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fltslot.py's filter_cost (mcengine.py's counter): all six tracks on it, the stock machines playing, a state held for 8 blocks after 8 of warm-up (off: Amount 0; mid: C4, Amount 127, Decay and Brightness 64; low: C1 with Decay 127 and Brightness 32, the line still being cleared; high: C7, the same; glide: every word jumping every block, the coefficients worked out each time; silent: no note played), the maximum, and the block in which the tracks come to it from none (its reset and first block); the filter slot's own instructions apart

proof.why: tools/emu/test_fltslot.py builds the model from host (reso.c's C frames, the model of reso_cf.S) and counts cost.emulation in cost_states (k 28 to k 31 of the blocks, in turn; silent plays no note), notes/73 §16
